# Abilities

<!-- Generated by `rake docs` from the primitive registry. Do not edit. -->

## activated

An activated ability: announce it, choose targets, pay its costs, then it goes on the stack. `timing: "sorcery"` restricts it to sorcery speed, `"your_turn"` to your turns; `limit: "once_each_turn"` to one activation per turn; `only_if` to when a condition holds. `zone` ("exile", "graveyard" or "hand") makes it function only while its card is in that zone ("activate only if this card is exiled").

Rules: CR 602.1, CR 602.2, CR 602.5b, CR 602.5d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | list of costs (tap, {"mana": "{1}"}, {"mana": "{X}"}) |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |
| `timing` | "instant" (default), "sorcery" or "your_turn" |
| `limit` | "once_each_turn" (CR 602.5b) |
| `only_if` | condition ("activate only if ...") |
| `zone` | "exile" | "graveyard" | "hand" (CR 113.6b; default: the battlefield, or the zone a cost moves the card from) |
| `cost_reduction` | {"amount": amount, "if": condition}: "this ability costs {N} less to activate" (CR 601.2f, 602.2b) |

```json
{
  "activated": {
    "cost": [
      "tap"
    ],
    "targets": [
      "any_target"
    ],
    "effects": [
      {
        "deal_damage": {
          "amount": 1,
          "to": {
            "target": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## additional_cost

As an additional cost to cast this spell, pay `cost` too (mana and/or chosen costs such as `sacrifice_permanent`). The spell can't be cast without it.

Rules: CR 601.2b, CR 601.2f, CR 601.2h, CR 118.8

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | list of costs |

```json
{
  "additional_cost": {
    "cost": [
      {
        "sacrifice_permanent": {
          "filter": "creature"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## additional_triggers

While this permanent is on the battlefield, a triggered ability of a permanent its controller controls that triggers because of `cause` triggers an additional time. `cause`: you_gain_life (its controller gaining life).

Rules: CR 603.2d, CR 119.9

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cause` | you_gain_life |

```json
{
  "additional_triggers": {
    "cause": "you_gain_life"
  }
}
```

## beam_me_up

You may cast this instant or sorcery card from your graveyard for `cost` plus returning a creature you control to its owner's hand, instead of its mana cost. If you do, it's exiled whenever it would leave the stack. Offered as a cast option with `via: "beam:<ref>"`.

Rules: CR 702.196a, CR 702.196b, CR 118.9, CR 601.2b, CR 601.2f, CR 601.2h

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | mana cost string, e.g. "{3}{W}" |

```json
{
  "beam_me_up": {
    "cost": "{3}{W}"
  }
}
```

## cant_be_blocked_by

This creature can't be blocked by creatures matching `filter` (checked as blockers are declared, with their current characteristics).

Rules: CR 509.1b, CR 509.1a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `filter` | a creature filter, e.g. {"creature": {"power": {"at_most": 2}}} |

```json
{
  "cant_be_blocked_by": {
    "filter": {
      "creature": {
        "power": {
          "at_most": 2
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## cant_be_targeted_by

This permanent can't be the target of abilities its controller's opponents control whose source matches `abilities_from` (a card spec, e.g. {"types": ["artifact"]}).

Rules: CR 115.4, CR 113.7, CR 702.11d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `abilities_from` | card spec of the ability's source |

```json
{
  "cant_be_targeted_by": {
    "abilities_from": {
      "types": [
        "artifact"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## chapter

A Saga's chapter ability: triggers when lore counters put on it bring their number from below `chapter` to at least `chapter`. Its targets are chosen as it's put on the stack. A Saga's final chapter number is its greatest `chapter`.

Rules: CR 715.2, CR 715.2b, CR 715.2c, CR 715.2d, CR 122.6

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `chapter` | integer >= 1 (the chapter symbol's number) |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |
| `modes` | optional modes, as for a spell |

```json
{
  "chapter": {
    "chapter": 2,
    "effects": [
      {
        "gain_life": {
          "amount": 3
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

As this permanent enters, its controller chooses a card name among the cards in the game (`not`: card types the named card mustn't have, e.g. ["land"]); abilities of it that say "the chosen name" use it.

Rules: CR 614.12, CR 614.12a, CR 201.4, CR 201.4a, CR 607.2

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `not` | list of card types |

```json
{
  "choose_card_name": {
    "not": [
      "land"
    ]
  }
}
```

As this permanent enters, its controller chooses a number from `min` to `max`; abilities of it that say "the chosen number" use it.

| --- | --- |

## cost_modifier

While on the battlefield: spells cast by `caster` (you, opponent or any; default you) whose card types match `spells` ({"any_of": [types], "not": [types]}, default all spells) cost `reduce` less or `increase` more generic mana.

Rules: CR 601.2f, CR 118.7a, CR 604.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `spells` | {"any_of": [types], "not": [types]} (optional) |
| `caster` | you | opponent | any |
| `reduce` | amount |
| `increase` | amount |

```json
{
  "cost_modifier": {
    "spells": {
      "not": [
        "creature"
      ]
    },
    "reduce": 1
  }
}
```

## cost_reduction

This spell costs `amount` generic mana less to cast, if the optional `if` condition holds when its total cost is determined (after targets are chosen). `amount` may be computed, e.g. {"count": {"each": "artifact", "controller": "you"}} for affinity for artifacts (CR 702.41a). It can't reduce colored mana or go below {0}.

Rules: CR 601.2f, CR 118.7a, CR 702.41a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | amount (integer or computed) |
| `if` | condition (optional) |

```json
{
  "cost_reduction": {
    "amount": 1,
    "if": {
      "attacked": true
    }
  }
}
```

## cycling

Cycling: pay `cost` and discard this card from your hand to draw a card. With `for` it is typecycling: instead search your library for a card matching `for`, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

Rules: CR 702.29a, CR 702.29b, CR 702.29e, CR 702.29f, CR 113.6m, CR 602.2a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | mana cost string, e.g. "{2}" |
| `for` | optional card spec for typecycling (see search_library) |

```json
{
  "cycling": {
    "cost": "{2}",
    "for": {
      "supertypes": [
        "basic"
      ],
      "types": [
        "land"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## destroy_replacement

If a permanent matching `affects` would be destroyed (by an effect, lethal damage or deathtouch), instead: all its `remove_counters` counters are removed (if given) and, with `remove_damage: true`, all damage marked on it is removed. Sacrificing isn't destroying, and 0 toughness isn't either.

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 614.8, CR 701.8a, CR 701.21a, CR 704.5f, CR 704.5g, CR 704.5h

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": bool} |
| `remove_counters` | counter name |
| `remove_damage` | boolean |

```json
{
  "destroy_replacement": {
    "affects": {
      "each": {
        "creature": {
          "counters": "+1/+1"
        }
      },
      "controller": "you",
      "other": true
    },
    "remove_counters": "+1/+1",
    "remove_damage": true
  }
}
```

## double_counters

While this permanent is on the battlefield, if its controller would put one or more counters (only `counter`, if given) on a permanent matching `affects` ({"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any}, relative to this permanent's controller), the number put is doubled. This includes counters a permanent enters with.

Rules: CR 614.1a, CR 122.6, CR 122.6a, CR 616.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": ...} |
| `counter` | optional counter name |

```json
{
  "double_counters": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## draw_replacement

While this permanent is on the battlefield, each time its controller would draw a card, they draw `amount` cards instead (even with an empty library). The draws it makes aren't replaced by it again, but another such effect applies to each of them.

Rules: CR 614.11, CR 614.11a, CR 614.5, CR 121.2, CR 616.1

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `amount` | integer >= 2 |

```json
{
  "draw_replacement": {
    "amount": 2
  }
}
```

## enchant

The Aura's enchant ability: a target filter for what its spell targets and what the Aura may be attached to, e.g. "creature" or {"permanent": {"any_of": ["artifact", "creature"]}}. Only Auras have it.

Rules: CR 702.5a, CR 115.1b, CR 303.4a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `(value)` | a target filter for a permanent |

```json
{
  "enchant": "creature"
}
```

## enter_as_copy

As this permanent enters, its controller may choose a permanent on the battlefield matching `of`; it enters as a copy of that permanent (its copiable values, with the `except` modifications) and its enter abilities trigger. `with_counters: true`: it also enters with the counters the copied permanent has. Choosing none: it enters as itself.

Rules: CR 707.5, CR 707.9b, CR 614.1c, CR 614.12

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `of` | filter (the permanents it may copy) |
| `except` | {"legendary": false, "keywords": [...], "types": [...], "subtypes": [...], "supertypes": [...], "name": ..., "power": n, "toughness": n, "colors": [...]} |
| `with_counters` | boolean |

```json
{
  "enter_as_copy": {
    "of": {
      "permanent": {
        "any_of": [
          "artifact",
          "creature"
        ]
      }
    },
    "except": {
      "legendary": false
    },
    "with_counters": true
  }
}
```

## enters_attacking

While this permanent's controller controls an attacking creature, permanents matching `affects` enter the battlefield tapped and attacking (the defending player). They never "attacked", so attack triggers don't see them.

Rules: CR 614.1c, CR 508.4, CR 506.4

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any} |

```json
{
  "enters_attacking": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    }
  }
}
```

## enters_with_counters

Without `affects`: this permanent enters with the `counters` on it. With `affects` ({"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": true}, relative to this permanent's controller): while this permanent is on the battlefield, each matching permanent enters with the `counters` in addition to any others.

Rules: CR 614.1c, CR 614.12, CR 122.6, CR 122.6a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `counters` | {counter name: n} (n >= 1) |
| `affects` | optional {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": bool} |

```json
{
  "enters_with_counters": {
    "counters": {
      "+1/+1": 1
    },
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you",
      "other": true
    }
  }
}
```

A loyalty ability. Its cost adds (positive) or removes (negative) loyalty counters and is paid on activation. Sorcery speed, and only one loyalty ability per planeswalker per turn.

| Parameter | Description |

```json
          "amount": 3,

          }
```

## mana

An activated mana ability: pay the cost, add the mana to your mana pool immediately. It does not use the stack and can be activated whenever you have priority.

Rules: CR 605.1a, CR 605.3a, CR 605.3b, CR 106.4

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | list of costs (e.g. ["tap"]) |
| `produce` | mana symbols added, e.g. "{G}" or "{C}{C}" |

```json
{
  "mana": {
    "cost": [
      "tap"
    ],
    "produce": "{C}"
  }
}
```

## play_from

With `cards: "self"` (default): its owner may cast this card from `zone` (the ability functions there). With a card spec: while this permanent is on the battlefield, its controller may play their own matching cards from `zone`. `play`: "cast" (spells only, default) or "play" (lands too). `once_each_turn`: once during each of your turns. `enters_with`: a permanent spell cast this way enters with these counters. Timing and costs are the usual ones.

Rules: CR 601.3, CR 113.6e, CR 113.6f, CR 305.1, CR 401.5, CR 122.1, CR 614.12

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `zone` | graveyard | exile | library_top |
| `cards` | "self" or a card spec |
| `play` | cast | play |
| `once_each_turn` | boolean |
| `enters_with` | {counter name: n} |

```json
{
  "play_from": {
    "zone": "graveyard",
    "enters_with": {
      "finality": 1
    }
  }
}
```

## player_rule

While this permanent is on the battlefield, `rule` applies to the players in `affects` (you | opponents | each; default you). Rules: hexproof, cant_attack, no_max_hand_size, prevent_all_damage, cant_lose_for_life, cant_sacrifice. `cant_sacrifice` takes a `filter` of the permanents that can't be sacrificed.

Rules: CR 702.11c, CR 115.4, CR 508.1c, CR 402.2, CR 514.1, CR 615.1, CR 615.1a, CR 704.5a, CR 104.3b, CR 701.21a, CR 614.17b, CR 604.1, CR 611.3a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `rule` | hexproof | cant_attack | no_max_hand_size | prevent_all_damage | cant_lose_for_life | cant_sacrifice |
| `affects` | you | opponents | each |
| `filter` | permanent filter (cant_sacrifice only) |

```json
{
  "player_rule": {
    "rule": "cant_sacrifice",
    "filter": {
      "permanent": {
        "token": true,
        "subtypes": [
          "treasure"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## spell

The spell ability of an instant or sorcery: its targets are chosen while casting and its effects happen in order when it resolves. If every target is illegal on resolution, it doesn't resolve.

Rules: CR 113.3a, CR 601.2c, CR 608.2b, CR 608.2c

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |

```json
{
  "spell": {
    "targets": [
      "any_target"
    ],
    "effects": [
      {
        "deal_damage": {
          "amount": 3,
          "to": {
            "target": 0
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## static

While its source is on the battlefield (and its `if` condition holds), every permanent it `affects` gets `pump` (fixed or computed amounts, layer 7c), the `keywords` and granted `abilities` (layer 6, triggered or mana abilities), and with `creature_types` has exactly those creature types (layer 4). `affects` is {"each": filter, "controller": you|opponent|any, "other": true} (relative to the source's controller), "self", or "attached" ("equipped/enchanted creature").

Rules: CR 604.1, CR 604.2, CR 611.3a, CR 613.1d, CR 613.1f, CR 613.4c, CR 205.1a, CR 301.5f, CR 303.4m

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `affects` | {"each": filter, "controller": ..., "other": bool}, "self" or "attached" |
| `if` | condition ("as long as ...", "during your turn") |
| `pump` | {"power": amount, "toughness": amount} ("gets +1/+1 for each ...") |
| `keywords` | list of keywords |
| `creature_types` | list of creature types (replaces the others) |
| `abilities` | list of triggered or mana abilities the affected permanents have |

```json
{
  "static": {
    "affects": {
      "each": "creature",
      "controller": "you"
    },
    "pump": {
      "power": 1,
      "toughness": 1
    }
  }
}
```

| `power` | integer |
| `toughness` | integer |
| `keywords` | list of keywords |
| `abilities` | list of abilities |

```json
{
  "station_symbol": {
    "at": 6,
    "power": 3,
    "toughness": 4,
    "keywords": [
      "flying"
    ]
  }
}
```

## triggered

A triggered ability: when its trigger condition happens, it is put on the stack the next time a player would receive priority (in APNAP order), with targets chosen then.

Rules: CR 603.2, CR 603.3, CR 603.3b, CR 603.3d

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `when` | a trigger condition, e.g. {"enters": {}} |
| `targets` | list of target filters |
| `effects` | list of effects |
| `if` | condition: an intervening "if", checked when it triggers and on resolution (CR 603.4) |
| `while` | condition checked only when it triggers ("whenever you attack while ...", CR 603.2) |
| `limit` | "once_each_turn": it triggers at most once each turn (per object) |
| `zone` | "graveyard": the ability functions only while its card is in a graveyard (CR 113.6k) |

```json
{
  "triggered": {
    "when": {
      "enters": {}
    },
    "effects": [
      {
        "draw": {
          "amount": 1
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Ward: whenever this permanent becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless its controller pays `cost`.

Rules: CR 702.21a, CR 601.2c, CR 603.2, CR 701.6a

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `cost` | mana cost string, e.g. "{2}" |

```json
{
  "ward": {
    "cost": "{2}"
  }
}
```
